items.title: Two Former Robinhood Employees Charged with Fraud
items.summary: Federal prosecutors have charged two former staffers at Robinhood Markets with fraud, according to a complaint filed Tuesday in the Southern District of New York.  The complaint alleges that the two defendants were working as engineers at Robinhood when they used confidential company information to trade perpetual futures on the trading platform Hyperliquid.  The former employees, Hefu Chai and Huaisong Xiang, allegedly used information in emails and Slack channels to buy perpetual futures linked to crypto tokens, ahead of announcements that those tokens would be listed on the Robinhood Crypto platform.

items.title: Bitcoin, Crypto Stocks Fall as Clarity Act Fails to Advance Past Procedural Vote
items.summary: The Clarity Act, a bill which would have established a regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies and other digital assets, has failed to pass a procedural Senate vote. The votes fell short of the 60 needed to invoke cloture, or to progress the bill to the next stage, coming in at 49 votes in favor.

items.title: Robinhood Staffers Charged With Crypto-Related Trading Fraud
items.summary: Two Robinhood Markets Inc. employees were charged by US prosecutors with fraud for allegedly using nonpublic information to trade crypto-linked perpetual futures on a decentralized derivatives exchange.
